name: io.github.mad4ms/comdirect-mcp
title: comdirect
description: Read access to comdirect balances, transactions, portfolios, securities, orders and postbox documents.

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: comdirect API client id (or stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: comdirect API client secret (or stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: comdirect Zugangsnummer (or stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: comdirect PIN (or stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_MCP_PUSH_TAN_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the push TAN approval if the client cannot show a confirmation dialog

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_MCP_UNMASK_IBANS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to return counterparty IBANs unmasked

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_MCP_MASK_NAMES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to replace counterparty names with stable pseudonyms

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a dotenv file with the credentials (opt-in; prefer the OS keychain)
